name: mcpp-emit-broken
description: An mcpp that can emit a build database (mcpp-community/mcpp#636, simulated by mcppls-mock-mcpp) answering with an error: the user sees mcpp's own diagnostic, sources are scanned meanwhile, and nothing is configured or written into the project in its place.
